parameters.name: BaselineItemList
parameters.description:
The baseline check items.

> You can call the [DescribeImageBaselineStrategy](~~DescribeImageBaselineStrategy~~) operation to query baseline check items.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The data source. If this parameter is left empty, the baseline check policy for images is queried. Valid values:

*   **default**: the baseline check policy for images
*   **agentless**: agentless detection

parameters.name: StrategyId
parameters.description:
The ID of the baseline check policy.

> You can call the [DescribeImageBaselineStrategy](~~DescribeImageBaselineStrategy~~) operation to query the IDs of baseline check policies.

parameters.name: StrategyName
parameters.description: The name of the baseline check policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas save-image-baseline-strategy --baseline-item-list ak_leak --strategy-id 8639 --strategy-name default --lang zh --source agentless --image-vul-clean 90 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas SaveImageBaselineStrategy --region cn-hangzhou --BaselineItemList ak_leak --StrategyName default --ImageVulClean 90 --StrategyId 8639 --Lang zh --Source agentless
